supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible lateral extension beyond the outer ocular corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between light-grey/white muzzle and dark-black periocular/cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick 2D vertical dimension with structural droop of the lower lip

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: rounded apex on the left ear (image right); right ear (image left) is distorted
pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: apparent amputation or severe collapse of the upper quadrant of the right ear (image left)

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: significant structural loss/deformity of the upper right ear cartilage
other_distinctive_markers: dense white/grey hair growth localized to the chin and lower muzzle boundary
